The crime, known as the blue drum murder case, involved dismembering Rajput's remains. Following a complex trial, which included 126 hearings and 22 witnesses, both were found guilty. The prosecution labeled the crime as one of the rarest of rare cases requiring the death penalty.
title: Muskan Rastogi, her lover Sahil Shukla sentenced to death in blue drum murder case

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
title: Bezos targets a sustainable lunar base after investing $28 billion since 2000

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: Sunil Mittal said: "I think I am significantly ahead in the queue from him (Elon Musk). I applied five years back." His remarks came in response to a question about Musk's recent criticism of India's telecom billionaires amid the ongoing debate over satellite internet services in the country.
title: ‘Ahead of Starlink in queue’: Sunil Mittal hopes OneWeb gets nod days Elon Musk

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: The Boxing Federation of India (BFI) has suspended its secretary general Pramod Kumar with immediate effect over alleged financial irregularities, failure to cooperate with investigations and misuse of authority. BFI president Ajay Singh issued the suspension order on Tuesday, pending an inquiry into the allegations against Kumar. These include issuing a work order for broadcasting arrangements without the required approval.
title: BFI suspends secretary general Pramod Kumar over alleged financial irregularities

author: PRACHI KUMAWAT
description: In a dramatic scene late Tuesday night, flames engulfed the kitchen of Udham Fish Point restaurant in Maujpur. Witnesses describe the moment when a woman jumped to a nearby terrace in a bid to evade the fire. Quick-thinking staff were able to extinguish the blaze before it escalated, and fortunately, there were no injuries. Authorities are now investigating the incident to uncover what sparked the fire.
title: Delhi fire scare: People jump from first floor as flames break out at Maujpur restaurant

author: SAURABH THAKUR
description: The Chandigarh state consumer commission upheld a ruling requiring Air India and Thakural Travels to refund a passenger. This followed the cancellation of a connecting flight from New Delhi to Toronto without proper notification. The complainant had previously booked the journey and incurred additional costs due to the cancellation. The commission found that the companies exhibited deficiency in service and unfair trade practices.
title: Air India cancelled flight, passengers left stranded; commission orders Rs 1.34L payout

author: PRISHA PATNAIK
title: 'Murdering democracy': Opposition slams Centre for the arrest of CJP leaders

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: During a thrilling family game drive in Zimbabwe, Oscar Whitfield captured an extraordinary moment with a dung beetle, earning him the prestigious Young Grand Title at the 2026 Wildlife Photographer of the Year competition. Notable winners included Federico Veronesi, Amelie Davis, and James Lewin, each celebrated for their stunning depictions of wildlife. The captivating exhibition showcasing these masterpieces will commence at the Natural History Museum on Friday, 16 October 2026.
title: Oscar Whitfield wins Young Wildlife Photographer title with dung beetle image

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: In 2022, the woman applied for 130 shares in an IPO. However, the bank recorded her application for just 65 shares, which she claimed resulted in a loss of Rs 42,142. She also accused the bank of causing her physical and mental harassment. The Gujarat State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission subsequently partly allowed the woman’s appeal.
title: Woman applies for 130 shares, bank enters 65; commission awards Rs 37,000, not Rs 40L

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: The European Commission has recommended postponing the enforcement of methane emissions regulations concerning oil and gas imports. This shift comes amid pressure from nations like France and the United States, focusing on energy supply challenges. Concerns regarding potential expenses and compliance issues raised by EU member states have also played a role.
title: EU proposes one-year delay to methane rules for oil and gas imports

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Weeds can significantly impact crop yield, leading to a need for effective control methods. A USDA-funded trial demonstrated that cardboard beds reduced weed coverage compared to tilled beds. Farmers found that using cardboard made weeding easier and more efficient after two growing seasons. The results from the trial showed varied crop yields when grown in different bed types.
title: Cardboard garden beds cut weed cover to 15% by second season in USDA trial

author: TOI WORLD DESK
title: Meet Daniil Prokofev, 17, whose safer walking app is being piloted by 14 schools

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In 2012, Rihanna made a generous donation of $1.75 million in medical equipment to the Queen Elizabeth Hospital in Barbados, honoring her late grandmother Clara Brathwaite. This contribution not only modernized the hospital's cancer-care services but also established the Clara Brathwaite Centre. Today, it plays a crucial role in delivering essential cancer treatments like chemotherapy and radiotherapy, significantly enhancing healthcare accessibility for the community.
title: Rihanna gave $1.75m for Barbados cancer care; centre still treats patients

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Daily responsibilities can often leave parents feeling inundated, affecting how they relate to their children. This stress may translate into noticeable emotional or behavioral shifts in kids, indicative of their internal struggles. Establishing a welcoming atmosphere for children to communicate their feelings is vital. By acknowledging their own stress and responding appropriately, parents can better support their children. Prioritizing their own well-being is essential for nurturing healthy family connections.
title: How constant stress at home can affect children’s behaviour and confidence

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: The third T20I against the West Indies was another milestone match for Abhishek Sharma. He became the sixth Indian men's cricketer to score 2,000 runs in T20 internationals. He also became the fastest batter in men's cricket to reach the milestone in terms of balls faced.
title: 'We immediately think of Chris Gayle': Pujara's big statement on Abhishek Sharma

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: Defence minister Rajnath Singh highlighted the pressing necessity for enhanced defence collaboration between India and ASEAN nations. He advocated for the joint production of military technologies and improvements in counter-drone capabilities, cyber defence, and maritime monitoring. Singh emphasized the significance of cost-effective defence innovations in contemporary warfare, referencing recent drone conflicts.
title: Rajnath Singh pitches joint defence production with ASEAN countries

title: Rahul stands with injured NSUI protesters, says 'nafrat ka jawab pyar se diya jaega'

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Satya Nadella's regret was not limited to his disagreement with the proposed acquisition. He said the experience made him think about how people in important meetings can fail to speak up even when they believe they see a problem that others may have missed
title: Microsoft CEO recalls a Bill Gates acquisition review that still haunts him

author: ABHAY
description: Daljeet Singh, a 29-year-old driver, died after being assaulted at a club in Inderlok. An argument over spilled beer escalated into a violent altercation involving club staff and security personnel. Daljeet was reportedly beaten for nearly an hour before being locked in a room. His condition worsened after returning home, leading to his hospitalization and subsequent death.
title: 'Manager's wife attacked with bottles': Beer spill, brawl and a killing at Delhi club

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: India is working to strengthen its relations with China, emphasizing the need for fair trade agreements and consistent engagement. The trade deficit with China has widened, raising concerns for India's economic outlook. Efforts are underway to enhance semiconductor cooperation with Singapore, focusing on workforce training. India is also fostering strong ties with the United States across various sectors, promoting trade and defense collaborations.
title: India rebuilding ties with China? Here’s what Piyush Goyal said

author: NEEL KAMAL
description: In a significant move, authorities have demolished the residence of Ashwani Kumar, the prime suspect in the murder of activist Parwinder Singh Jhota. Following Kumar's arrest in Rajasthan, protests erupted in Mansa as citizens rallied for justice. In response to public outrage, a Punjab bandh has been declared, reflecting the community's demand for accountability in the wake of this tragedy.
title: Anti-drug activist murder: Bulldozers raze accused’s house, shop set ablaze in Punjab

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
title: Drew Barrymore sold her Hollywood Hills home in 2018; nearly 4 times its price

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: India’s Amrit Vats and Pakistan’s Muhammad Yahya won the boys’ doubles title at the ITF Juniors J30 tournament in Djibouti, defeating their opponents 6-2, 6-4. Their victory revived memories of the famous Indo-Pak Express duo, Rohan Bopanna and Aisam-ul-Haq Qureshi, highlighting how tennis can bring athletes together despite political tensions between the neighbouring countries.
title: Indian teenager, Pakistan’s Yahya win tennis title, revive Indo-Pak Express memories

author: SMRITI JAIN
description: Gold price prediction today: Gold prices are trading cautiously, influenced by high US yields and the dollar index. Investors are still purchasing gold despite challenges in the physical market and slowed central bank acquisitions. The upcoming US September CPI is pivotal for the Federal Reserve's actions regarding interest rates.
title: Gold price prediction today: Will gold trade cautiously? Check outlook

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: Mary Millben has alleged that US-based donors are funding individuals opposing Prime Minister Narendra Modi. She encouraged young Indians to rise up against disruptive forces and defend democracy. Millben highlighted a pattern among some US donors targeting conservative leaders globally. BJP leaders have raised questions about the funding of the Cockroach Janta Party and its founder. Dipke has denied allegations of receiving foreign funds, challenging government oversight.
title: 'Abhijieet Dipke, CJP funded by US donors': Singer Mary Millben backs PM Modi

title: 'Putin doesn't consider Trump's statements strong': Zelenskyy slams Russia strikes

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: New research from Texas A&M University indicates that polyethylene microplastics may affect liver health negatively. The study observed significant signs of fatty liver disease linked to polyethylene exposure and a high-fat diet. Researchers found changes in gene activity related to fat metabolism and tissue repair. Future investigations will focus on whether these pollutants contribute to more severe liver damage.
title: Microplastics worsen fatty liver signs, especially with unhealthy diet: Study

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: On October 11, a frantic search ensued for two young brothers, Atom and Jack Ward, who vanished while playing outside. Their worried father alerted authorities when they didn't return home. A collaborative effort involving local businesses and rescue teams, along with aerial support from the Arizona Department of Public Safety, led to their discovery six miles from home, with one boy still barefoot.
title: Arizona brothers, 10 and 12, found safe after 8-hour desert search

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In May 2020, Olivia Culpo established More Than a Mask, an initiative aimed at combatting food insecurity worsened by the pandemic. By selling masks and collaborating with Feeding America, she provided meals to those in need. Culpo later partnered with Express to generate further donations for various charities, driven by her family's philanthropic spirit.
title: Olivia Culpo’s hunger initiative helped fund over 3 million meals across US

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: For over 60 years, the Luidhardt family has been dedicated to farming their land in Ohio, which was under threat from a proposed pipeline for Meta's data center. In a determined bid to protect their legacy, they challenged the route, leading to crucial legal discussions about how corporate interests impact family-run farms.
title: Ohio family challenges pipeline across 40-acre farm; developer changes route

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: OpenAI has made the decision to dismiss an engineering lead due to the discovery of a hidden recording device in a conference room. This device was secretly monitoring confidential discussions about AI technology. The technical surveillance team identified the breach, leading to the arrest of Abdulrahman Alfozan, who faces charges for intercepting oral communications. The FBI is actively investigating the incident, highlighting the critical need to safeguard AI innovations.
title: OpenAI fires employees after spying device found in office

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: WFI president Sanjay Singh criticised the US Embassy after nine Indian wrestlers were denied visas for the 2026 U23 World Wrestling Championships in Las Vegas, blaming the decision for costing India potential gold medals. While the men’s freestyle team received clearance, Greco-Roman and women’s wrestlers were affected. Vishvajit More reached the 55kg Greco-Roman final, keeping India’s gold medal hopes alive.
title: No jobs, no visas! WFI prez blasts US embassy: 'India lost out on gold medals'

author: RK LAXMI
description: Muskan Rastogi and her co-convict Sahil Shukla appeared before the court through video conferencing for sentencing. They were previously convicted of conspiring to murder Saurabh Rajput and hiding his body. Muskan has been requesting to meet her seven-year-old daughter during her time in jail. The judge questioned both convicts about various aspects of the case in a brief hearing. Jail authorities noted their anxiety and distress during this challenging period.
title: ‘Let me meet my daughter once’: Muskan Rastogi ahead of blue drum murder verdict

author: PRISHA PATNAIK
title: 'Rahul told us to be ready at 24 hours notice for protest': Anish Gawande

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: A missile attack targeted Saudi Aramco's administrative building, damaging upper floors of the headquarters complex. Authorities reported intercepting multiple missiles and drones aimed at various regions, including Riyadh. In Riyadh, fragments from intercepted missiles injured four individuals and damaged several homes. This incident follows a series of Houthi missile attacks against Saudi targets in recent days. The situation remains tense as Saudi Arabia faces continued threats from Houthi forces.
title: Houthis target Saudi Aramco compound, limited fire reported

author: PRISHA PATNAIK
title: Oil prices climb as Houthis step up attacks on Saudi Arabia, stoking supply fears

author: ARANI BASU
description: TOI understands that Krishna has been given a three-week timeline when he reported to the Centre of Excellence (CoE) after he walked out of the second ODI against West Indies in Guwahati on Sept 30. Seam-bowling allrounder Rana, who has been at the CoE since July, is expected to undergo a return-to-play match simulation on October 25 before the ODI and Test squads are expected to fly out on Oct 28 with the ODI series scheduled to start on Nov 4.
title: India's tour of NZ: Prasidh Krishna, Harshit Rana's fitness delays team selection

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: Iran has altered its approach by focusing on attacks against commercial shipping in the Gulf region, aiming to boost global oil prices. This tactic is designed to apply economic pressure on the United States and its allies, complicating their strategies just ahead of the midterm elections. As tensions rise, the risk to multiple vessels may increase, potentially affecting energy costs for American consumers.
title: Iran shifts tactics, steps up ship attacks to pressure Trump before US midterms

author: PRISHA PATNAIK
description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio is set to embark on a visit to Mumbai and Jamnagar from October 17 to 22, during which he will engage in discussions aimed at enhancing strategic alliances and advancing energy collaborations. He plans to meet with key government officials and business leaders to uncover new investment opportunities.
title: US secretary of state Rubio to visit India next week for strategic, energy talks

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: Imai Yuki, a Japanese journalist, finds himself in a precarious situation after being detained in Russia, where the Federal Security Service has accused him of espionage linked to military intelligence gathering. This development arises against a backdrop of rising tensions between Japan and Russia, especially due to the ongoing Ukraine conflict. Japan's classification as an 'unfriendly' nation complicates matters further, intensifying the diplomatic rift.
title: Russia detains Japanese journalist for spying on strategic island

author: HADI KHAN
description: Shiva Sharma, a 27-year-old cafe owner, died after a fall from an apartment in Lucknow. Police initiated a murder investigation following a complaint from Sharma’s family about his suspected assault. The live-in partner, Shraddha Dubey, along with four others, has been booked in connection to the case. Family members alleged that Sharma was held captive and tortured before his death.
title: 6 teams, Rs 25k reward: Hunt on for model Shraddha Dubey in UP bizman's death case

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: Former India cricketer Shikhar Dhawan has denied participating in an upcoming franchise T20 league, claiming organisers used his name without his knowledge or permission. In a post on X, he said his team would take appropriate legal action and urged the media and fans to ignore unauthorised announcements. Dhawan has represented India across all three international cricket formats.
title: 'My name used without permission': Dhawan to take legal action against league

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: In a recent collaborative military drill named Eagles of Civilization 2026, Chinese pilots participated in air combat exercises with Egyptian Rafale and MiG-29 aircraft in Egypt. The focus was on enhancing close-range manoeuvring skills and electronic warfare tactics. The J-16 fighters, supported by KJ-500 airborne early warning aircraft, displayed their strengths in simulated combat, while Egyptian pilots took special interest in the electronic jamming techniques demonstrated by the Chinese force.
title: What Chinese pilots revealed about Rafale, MiG-29 after Egypt air drills

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: A man bought a residential property jointly with his wife and his father. The Income Tax Department reopened his assessment for the 2016-17 assessment year after receiving information through its Risk Management Strategy that he had purchased an immovable property during the 2015-16 financial year. The man then approached the ITAT, challenging both the addition and the calculation underlying it.
title: Taxman adds Rs 55.2 lakh over joint Rs 80 lakh property; ITAT grants relief

author: PRISHA PATNAIK
title: 'Makes such claims all the time’: BJP dismisses TMC’s Mamata knife attack allegation

author: ABHAY
description: A 29-year-old driver named Daljeet Singh was killed after an altercation at a club in Delhi. The incident began when he accidentally spilled beer on the club manager's wife during her birthday celebration. Following a violent confrontation, Daljeet and his friends were assaulted by the club staff. After returning home, Daljeet fell ill, prompting his wife to take him to the hospital.
title: Delhi man beaten to death for spilling beer on club manager's wife

title: Is Netanyahu urging Trump to strike Iran before US, Israel polls?

author: SAURABH THAKUR
description: The Bombay high court addressed a case regarding cruelty allegations under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code. The court found that asking a woman to wash clothes and utensils did not amount to cruelty. Additionally, it quashed the charges against six relatives due to vague allegations lacking specifics. The court noted that the relatives lived separately from the woman and her claims lacked detail.
title: Is asking wife to wash clothes and utensils cruelty? Bombay HC explains Section 498A

author: HADI KHAN
description: Cockroach Janata Party leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka were arrested for violating protest-related regulations. They allegedly breached barricades and entered a protest site designated for demonstrations. Their arrests are a response to ongoing protests against alleged irregularities in electoral rolls. The Delhi Police recently designated new protest venues, moving demonstrations away from the political center. The CJP criticized this move, claiming it weakens public dissent visibility.
title: CJP’s Das, Ranka sent to Tihar Jail for 5 days over Jantar Mantar trespass

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: Qais Ahmed grabbed attention in the closing stages of the one-off Test between Afghanistan and Bangladesh in Abu Dhabi. The Afghanistan batter's injury moment reminded fans of Gulbadin Naib's incident during the 2024 T20 World Cup. Afghanistan put up a determined batting effort to secure a draw at the Sheikh Zayed Stadium. The hosts batted for 142 overs to avoid defeat against their Asian rivals.
title: Drama! Qais Ahmed's injury moment brings back memories of Naib's incident

author: ABHISHEK MISHRA
title: 'With our tigress': Dhruv Rathee shares picture with Neha Bora after Oct 10 detention

author: ABHAY
description: Delhi Police have filed four FIRs regarding protests linked to the INDIA bloc and associated violations. These cases involve barricade violations and road defacement, according to police sources. Additionally, four FIRs pertain to disinformation initiatives believed to be linked to social media accounts based in Pakistan. Investigators are focusing on over 100 suspicious social media handles aiming to spread anti-India narratives.
title: 4 FIRs over INDIA bloc march; takedown request for 500 pieces of content

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Google CEO Sundar Pichai announced the global launch of the Gemini 4 Argon AI model for developers and businesses. This AI model is designed to handle complex tasks in various fields, including coding and finance. Elon Musk praised the effective communication method of CEOs using social media directly to share product news. The initial pricing for the AI model is set, with discounted rates available until late 2026.
title: Elon Musk congratulates CEOs & execs after Google CEO announces Gemini 4 Argon

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Nithya Tammana, a passionate young advocate, noticed rampant water wastage at home, prompting her to launch Save Drop. This initiative has attracted over 450 young changemakers dedicated to preserving water resources. Through impactful campaigns, she stresses the necessity of altering daily water conservation habits. Furthermore, she developed BioLayer, a nature-inspired water filter designed to enhance water quality, earning accolades for her contributions to environmental sustainability.
title: New Jersey girl, 11, builds moss filter designed to remove 95% of lead from water

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: India will look to seal the five-match T20I series when they face the West Indies in the fourth match at the Rajiv Gandhi International Stadium in Hyderabad on Wednesday. With India leading the series 2-1, the possibility of 15-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi getting a chance has once again become a major talking point.
title: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi drops two-word message ahead of India vs West Indies 4th T20I

author: PRACHI KUMAWAT
description: Bittu Tabahi's return to the Ajnar River after an eight-month cleanup revealed a heartbreaking reality; the river was heavily polluted again. In a poignant video, he shared his frustration and vowed to keep documenting the situation. Previously, he successfully removed large quantities of waste from the Yamuna and surrounding areas, yet the formidable challenge of sustaining these clean-ups amid persistent pollution persists.
title: Bittu Tabahi ‘heartbroken’ after finding garbage in river he cleaned for 8 months

author: TNN
description: In a harrowing incident, a daily-wage worker was arrested for the sexual assault of a minor girl at a temple. The incident unfolded on Sunday during the girl's visit with her parents. Thanks to CCTV footage, the police swiftly identified and apprehended the suspect. He now faces charges under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and the POCSO Act, while authorities work diligently to ensure justice for the victim.
title: Man held for sexually assaulting minor at temple near Pune, CCTV footage emerges

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: Israel's upcoming elections are poised to be dramatically influenced by smaller parties struggling to surpass the 3.25 percent voting threshold. Their performance could tip the scales between Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's coalition and the opposition. Historical patterns reveal how these parties, despite failing to secure seats, can pivotally alter political landscapes, emphasizing their crucial role in shaping the next government.
title: Israel election paradox as parties winning no seats could decide who forms government

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: In a significant policy shift, the US Department of Homeland Security has abolished the 540-day automatic extension for work permits. This development results in immediate loss of work authorization for many, particularly affecting H-4 visa holders and asylum seekers, even while their renewal applications are pending. Moreover, the USCIS continues to face notable delays in processing these renewals, leading to a legal challenge from impacted parties contesting the new regulation.
title: US ends 540-day grace period for immigrants after work authorisation expires

author: DEV KUMAR
description: In a significant turn of events, the Patna High Court has changed Mohammad Ainul Haq's conviction from rape to indecent assault due to lack of supporting evidence for the original allegations. While the victim provided testimony, other witnesses did not support the claims, and the court cited the absence of medical proof like bruises. As a result, Haq was fined Rs 25,000 and ordered to compensate the victim.
title: Lying atop woman, sans backing proof, can't be held as rape: Patna high court

description: Former The Real Housewives of Potomac star Mia Thornton faces a felony theft-by-taking charge over allegations that she and Jared McGriff removed furniture and a television worth approximately $11,000 from a furnished Atlanta condo in October 2025. Luis Figo, Carles Puyol and Iker Casillas are among the names reportedly expected, though official squads remain unconfirmed. The exhibition follows last year’s meeting in Mumbai, where Real Madrid Legends won 2-0, and adds another chapter to Kolkata’s rich footballing history.
title: El Clasico in Kolkata: Barca and Real icons set for Salt Lake clash on Nov 25

author: NITESH DUBEY
description: South Africa faced a significant defeat against Australia by 214 runs in the first Test at Durban. This loss caused South Africa to drop to third place in the ICC World Test Championship standings. Australia, with nine wins from eleven matches, remains at the top of the table. Matt Renshaw was instrumental in Australia's success, scoring 190 runs in the first innings.
title: WTC table: SA crash out of top two after Durban defeat; Where are India?

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: A dedicated research team has unveiled hidden materials by analyzing molecular transformations during heating. Their discovery includes a newly identified form of bismuth vanadate that boasts an expanded band gap, potentially revolutionizing solar energy applications. Furthermore, they pinpointed transient phases with remarkable lithium storage capabilities, hinting at advancements in battery technology.
title: Scientists discover ‘hidden materials’ that may lead to better batteries and solar fuels
